name: technical-bridge
description: Technical Bridge & DataBridge — microservicios, gateway y SPA

scripts.predev: node scripts/mvnw.js -N install -DskipTests && node scripts/mvnw.js -pl common install -DskipTests
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gw,auth,debt,pay,ai,web -c magenta,cyan,blue,yellow,green,white "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:debt" "npm run start:payments" "npm run start:ai" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gw,auth,debt,pay,ai -c magenta,cyan,blue,yellow,green "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:debt" "npm run start:payments" "npm run start:ai"
